title: Sirt1 sustains Sonic hedgehog signaling to promote medulloblastoma progression through regulating Gli3 processing
task: Define Sirt1 role in Sonic hedgehog pathway activation and medulloblastoma progression
key_results: Sirt1 elevated in SHH-type MB; Sirt1 knockdown suppresses SHH signaling and MB proliferation; Sirt1 deacetylates Gli3FL, inhibiting proteolytic conversion to Gli3R repressor, sustaining pathway activation; Sirt1 inhibition extends survival in orthotopic models
comments: Identifies Sirt1 as critical positive regulator of SHH pathway through non-histone target (Gli3); pharmacological validation strengthens therapeutic relevance.

model_io.model: Genetically engineered mouse MB models (SHH-type) and primary/xenograft cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sirt1-mediated Gli3 deacetylation sustains SHH signaling in MB
hypotheses.result: Supported; Sirt1 knockdown increases Gli3 acetylation and reduces pathway activation and tumor growth

title: Decoding the CAF–TAM axis: multi-omics dissection and therapeutic targeting of stromal–immune crosstalk in the tumor microenvironment
task: Characterize CAF-TAM crosstalk and therapeutic targeting in tumor microenvironment
key_results: Multi-omics profiling reveals bidirectional signaling networks between CAF and TAM subpopulations orchestrating immune suppression, metabolic reprogramming, and therapeutic resistance
comments: Comprehensive review synthesizing recent technological advances; therapeutic translation requires validation of specific pathway dependencies in defined tumor contexts.

model_io.model: Multi-omics analysis (transcriptomic, epigenomic, metabolomic, spatial profiling)

hypotheses.hypothesis: CAF-TAM interaction promotes immune evasion and metabolic reprogramming
hypotheses.result: Supported by multi-omics evidence of coordinated signaling, ECM remodeling, and angiogenesis

title: Developmental system drift in dorsoventral patterning is linked to transitions to autonomous development in Annelida
task: Clarify BMP pathway ancestral role in dorsoventral patterning across Annelida
key_results: BMP acts downstream of ERK1/2 in ancestral annelids; signaling hierarchy is lost in species transitioning to unequal cleavage, with divergent reliance on Activin/Nodal or BMP for head patterning only
comments: Reveals developmental system drift as consequence of reproductive mode transitions; extensive rewiring of downstream targets suggests buffered rather than simply altered developmental programs.

model_io.model: Comparative embryonic developmental analysis (four annelid species)

hypotheses.hypothesis: BMP is ancestrally downstream of ERK1/2 in annelid dorsoventral patterning
hypotheses.result: Supported in species with equal spiral cleavage

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transition to unequal cleavage causes loss of BMP-ERK1/2 hierarchy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; species show Activin/Nodal or BMP-only head patterning with downstream target rewiring

title: Small-molecule FTO inhibitor MO-I-500 protects C8-B4 microglial cells from erastin-induced ferroptosis
task: Determine FTO role in erastin-induced ferroptosis regulation in microglial cells
key_results: FTO inhibition with MO-I-500 significantly decreased erastin-induced ferroptosis, reducing cell migration, ROS production, and lipid accumulation in C8-B4 microglial cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: FTO-mediated m6A demethylation promotes ferroptosis

title: m6A demethylase FTO promotes the progression of abdominal aortic aneurysm through PDK4-mediated apoptosis

key_results: FTO elevated in AAA models; silencing FTO partially reverses AngII-induced VSMC apoptosis via m6A demethylation of PDK4 mRNA (3' UTR), reducing YTHDF2-dependent PDK4 degradation; PDK4 overexpression reverses FTO-silencing apoptosis inhibition
comments: Elegant mechanistic model connecting epigenetic modification to metabolic enzyme function and apoptosis; however, PDK4's role as AAA driver versus VSMC-protective factor warrants clarification.

hypotheses.hypothesis: FTO demethylates PDK4 mRNA, promoting YTHDF2-dependent degradation and apoptosis

title: Comparative analysis of extracellular vesicles released from resting neutrophils under distinct pharmacological inhibition
